remarks:
Welcome to 659 70th Street! This charming, move-in-ready 3-bedroom, 1-bath ranch offers a bonus room and an impressive list of recent updates. The home features a new furnace, central air conditioning, hot water tank, and electrical panel, all updated in 2024, along with professionally blown-in insulation throughout the walls and ceiling. The roof is estimated to be approximately 2019.

Outside, you’ll find a large fully fenced yard, a 1.5-car garage, and a newer shed, providing plenty of space for entertaining, storage, and everyday living.

Nestled in a quiet neighborhood, this home is conveniently located near major shopping, schools, and public transportation. With the major updates already completed, there is little left to do but move in and enjoy!

Don’t miss your opportunity to make 659 70th Street your new home! Seller reserves the right to call for offers.
